resolved.title: getter和setter方法
resolved.problem_statement_md:
给定程序输入学生的姓名和年龄。

请完成该程序，为学生类的相应属性设置值，并打印出最终结果。

如果年龄小于0，程序应该输出提示信息 "not valid age"，并给年龄属性赋值为0。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Getters and Setters[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The program you are given receives name and age of student as input.
Complete the program to set the values for the corresponding attributes of the Student class and prints out the final result. If the age is <0, program should output "Invalid age" and assign a 0 value to the age attribute.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
Olivia
-2

[b]Sample Output[/b]
Invalid age
Name: Olivia
Age: 0

[b]Explanation[/b]
-2 is invalid value for age attribute, that's why "Invalid age" and "Age: 0" is printed. Setter and Getter should handle this.

[note]You need to handle the conditions inside the Getter and the Setter.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 你需要在getter和setter方法中处理这些条件。

testcases.expected_output:
not valid age
Name: Lora
Age: 0
